message: composer.lock was written by a Composer older than 2.11.0 (plugin-api-version 2.9.0), which does not support config.policy.cooldown.period (added in 2.11.0), so Composer applies no cooldown where that version runs
fix: Update Composer to 2.11.0 or later wherever the project is installed (composer self-update), then run composer update --lock and commit composer.lock
